preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 50000.
The number of sets n in each test case must be between 2 and 100,000.
Each set must contain between 2 and 100,000 integers.
Each integer in the sets must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The total number of elements in all sets across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: If no pair of similar sets is found, output -1.
If a pair of similar sets is found, output their indices i and j.
